body_html:
What an honor to be a part of such a great event. When we were asked to MC Sierra’s Race 2012 there was no hesitation! We look forward to hosting their event every year and continue to support such a helpful,encouraging and endearing event.

What an honor! What I take away from this great event is something that will stick with me for the rest of my life. Though I didn’t know Sierra personally her family is a testament to what she stood for. The honor was mine! ~From Steve Smith~
